county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - 15 clock hours Annual Training for Caregivers & Site Directors (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A site director did not have annual training hours: 3/6/2023 to 3/6/2024.

top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §744.701(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to share a copy of the incident report with the child's parents within 48 hours.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §744.1107(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: High School caregiver was observed supervising children while caregiver in charge was attending the cafeteria main entrance door.     Operation became in compliance when program director arrived.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. The operation reported the injury to Child Care Regulation on 4/12/2024; the operation was informed on 4/9/2024 that a young child received medical treatment for an accidental injury that occurred on 4/8/2024 while the young child was in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Food Allergies Posted Prominently (26 TAC §747.401(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have food allergy list posted.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.
